sculpt_stove_iron.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_stove_iron.notes: The shepherd's cast-iron stove (gameplay/errands-props.js makeStove): bowed legs, ribs, rivets, framed and barred fire door (the game's glow behind it), ash drawer, top plate with rings, flue with collars, damper and rain cap, a pot with lid and bail, hearth slab, split logs. Origin on the ground, door +Z; flue mouth (-0.18, 2.1, -0.12). LOD tris 3926 / 2562 / 606. Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, written once).
